item.title: Bulletin updated at 01:15 HKT 06/Jan/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A dry northeast monsoon will bring generally fine weather to southern China today and tomorrow. Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, it will be cloudy with a few rain patches over the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea early to midweek next week. With the monsoon moderating, winds will be weak over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of next week. It will be misty over the region.

Weather: Mainly cloudy. Dry with sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 17 - 22 C
R.H. range: 50 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
